# AppCatalyst

> Affordable app development for startups and small businesses. Founded by Chase Kellis, Senior Full Stack Developer based in Orange County, California. 25+ apps and 30+ websites shipped since 2019.

## About

AppCatalyst (App Catalyst LLC) builds custom mobile apps and websites at startup-friendly prices. US-based quality without overseas risk. One senior developer handles your entire project from start to finish.

## Services

- Custom Mobile App Development (iOS and Android) using React Native and Capacitor
- Website Design and Development using React
- Progressive Web App (PWA) Development
- Supabase Backend Development
- API Development and Integration
- MVP Development for Startups
- App Store Publishing (Apple App Store and Google Play)

## Pricing

- Simple websites starting at $1,000
- Standard mobile apps from $3,000 to $5,000
- Complex apps with custom backends quoted per project
- Fixed pricing, no hourly billing, no surprise costs

## Tech Stack

React, React Native, TypeScript, Supabase, Capacitor, Expo, Node.js, Netlify, PostgreSQL
